input.prompt: Flat vector illustration for a website hero, in a clean modern corporate flat-design style with soft rounded shapes, subtle grain texture on the large background blob, and simple geometric characters. Scene: on the left, a smiling accounts-payable clerk in a mustard-yellow sweater sits at a light blue desk with a laptop; beside the desk a tall stack of paper invoices and an envelope with more invoices arriving. In the centre, a friendly rounded AI scanner device in white and periwinkle blue with a glowing beam reads an invoice; small floating cards come out of it: a card with a matching tick between an invoice and a purchase order, a card with an approver avatar and a green check mark, and a card with a coin. A dotted periwinkle path carries these to a large accounting dashboard screen on the right with a ledger table, a small bar chart and a green paid stamp, where a finance manager in a periwinkle-blue shirt reviews it. A yellow lightbulb with sparkles and two pale yellow gears float in the background sky. Background: one large soft light-blue organic blob on a pure white background with a few flat pale clouds. Palette: periwinkle blue #4A72D8, pale blue #C9DDF6, very light blue #E7F0FB, mustard yellow #F5B84A, soft green #3BB273, dark navy line accents #1F2A44, white. Airy, balanced composition, wide 16:9 framing, clean white space around the blob. Strictly no text, no words, no letters, no numbers anywhere; every invoice, card and screen shows only abstract lines, bars and blocks.
input.negative_prompt: text, words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, typography, logos, watermark, signature, photorealistic, 3D render, dark background, heavy gradients, neon, orange magenta purple brand colors, robot chatbot mascot, clutter, extra limbs, distorted faces, blurry
